claims.claim_text: 一場 review 超過一小時就進入邊際效益遞減，人一小時能有效看的程式碼大約只有 400 行；人在 review AI 生成的程式時「更有信心、卻抓到更少 bug」
claims.evidence: "reviews that are longer than 1h quickly reach diminishing returns"; "a maximum of 400 LOC/H is a good maximum speed acceptable for efficience"; "humans that review code generated by LLM Coding Assistants are more confident that they found all the defects, while finding less defects".

claims.claim_text: 用 numactl 一限制看到最高 3 倍的差距；mediawiki benchmark 跑固定 10 分鐘；真正變快的是每秒指令數
claims.evidence: "using numactl to restrict thread scheduling to a single socket improved runtime by as much as 3x!"; benchmark config duration 10m; "Speedup was calculated with the assumption that instructions have been held constant, which was not the case for this benchmark." EEVDF, LAVD, L3 Read-for-Ownership Misses all present.

claims.claim_text: Shipyard 把基礎設施當成可部署的產物；核心是 slack-zero 黃金基底映像；實例幾秒就能上線；Peekaboo / Gondola / Reaper 管數以萬計的 EC2
claims.evidence: "Shipyard treats infrastructure as deployable artifacts rather than endlessly mutable instances"; base image "slack-zero"; "instances can become operational in seconds rather than minutes"; Peekaboo, Gondola, Reaper; "tens of thousands of EC2 instances".

claims.claim_text: 用在 LFM2-8B-A1B 上，印地語與越南語 token 數各降到約 1/2.4 與 1/2.6、泰語最多到 1/4，每字元解碼加速 2.2 到 3.7 倍
claims.evidence: "encodes Hindi and Vietnamese in roughly 2.4x and 2.6x fewer tokens than the source (up to 4.0x on Thai)"; "we estimate a 2.2-3.7x per-character decode speedup for these languages"; applied to a continued pre-trained checkpoint of LFM2-8B-A1B.

claims.claim_text: sealor 把還沒寫完的程式補成標準編譯器就能診斷的完整程式；不需改動模型內部；降低編不過的比例、拉高功能正確率
claims.evidence: "a sealor: a lightweight, mostly syntax-guided transformation that converts partial programs into complete ones that standard compilers can diagnose"; contrasted with constrained decoding which requires white-box access; "reduces non-compiling outputs and improves functional correctness".

claims.claim_text: 小學直式 O(n^2)，Karatsuba 約 O(n^1.585)，Harvey 與 van der Hoeven 2019 給出 O(n log n)（galactic）；Python 約 630 位數才切 Karatsuba；普遍相信 n log n 是極限但未證
claims.evidence: "scales with the square of the number of digits (n^2)"; "roughly O(n^1.585)"; 2019 Harvey-van der Hoeven "O(n log n)" is galactic; "around 630 decimal digits, it flips a switch and employs Karatsuba's algorithm"; "widely suspect that O(n log n) is the fastest possible speed... proving it has become the holy grail". Note: the specific year 1960 for Karatsuba was not surfaced verbatim in the fetched extract but is not contradicted.

claims.claim_text: Netflix 把 VMAF 推到 v1、舊版更名 v0；用 score transform 把 v1 刻度對齊回 v0，讓同一個數字維持原意
claims.evidence: "open-sourcing a new version of VMAF, with version number v1"; "VMAF v1 matches or outperforms v0 in most datasets"; "we calibrated the VMAF v1 scale to align with v0 via a score transform, so that the new algorithm preserves the meaning of the numbers while keeping its accuracy benefits".

claims.claim_text: Square 的 Kube-Policies 是在部署路徑上先攔一道的護欄，擋掉不合規的工作負載設定
claims.evidence: Admission controllers as "gatekeepers of everything that gets deployed to the clusters"; "creating guardrails instead of gates"; policy-as-code via OPA with staged monitoring/warning/denial enforcement.

claims.claim_text: Yufeng Gao 放出 0.1 版 IA-64 模擬器，能開 Windows Server 2003 與 XP 64-bit；Ryzen 5000 上約 486 等級效能；Linux/BSD 開不起來；程式碼未開源但作者說之後放 GitHub
claims.evidence: "Yufeng Gao ... has released version 0.1 of his Intel Itanium (IA-64) emulator"; "boots the Itanium version of Windows Server 2003 and Windows XP 64-bit"; "486-levels of performance on a Ryzen 5000 series"; "Linux / BSD also don't boot"; "The code is not open source ... it will be available" on GitHub.

claims.claim_text: Gleam 把原始碼鏡像到 tangled，一個建在 AT protocol 上的程式碼 forge；repo 身分與社交圖譜掛在去中心化的 AT 網路上
claims.evidence: Page header "gleam.run/gleam at main - Tangled"; clone URL with did:plc identity and per-commit DIDs show AT Protocol / decentralized-identity integration; Tangled positioned as an AT-Protocol forge with portable social graph.
